propositions: Pure intercept commands like verify-commit-ticket dispatch before store-mount logic, causing 'ticket store not found' errors in fresh linked worktrees despite needing to resolve ids against the store
Store-mount logic is replicated per dispatch-arm and entirely skipped by pure intercepts, making it structurally possible for commands to forget to mount the store
A single central CLI gate must execute mount-only initialization before both pure intercepts and set-based dispatch to guarantee every store-touching command auto-mounts the worktree
Policy-exempt commands (init, scratch, explain, pure no-store reads) must bypass the central mount gate and continue working without a mounted store
The REBAR_TRACKER_DIR override must still short-circuit the central gate so tests and embedding remain unaffected
